verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly establishes the rendered FAQ answers covering product, referral, prize, payment, wallet, resale, and support behavior.
The client explicitly revises the rendered FAQ and adds or changes concrete referral, wallet, resale, payment, network, badge, and revenue-allocation explanations.
The changed Small and Big Block prize counts and sales triggers necessarily update the corresponding values rendered in the FAQ.
The client explicitly requests a new fiat-buyer FAQ explaining wallet provisioning, dashboard access, commissions, prize tickets, notifications, and reward delivery.
Removing Big Blocks necessarily deletes the existing big_block_prize_copy key and revises all FAQ attributes that previously described Big Block tickets, funding, or payouts.
The client explicitly adds and revises rendered FAQ answers for fiat buyers, beginners, commissions, ticket assignment, VRF drawings, prize delivery, and notifications.
This is the first target-specific implementation claim after the immediately preceding request explicitly enumerated the revised and newly added FAQ content.
The client establishes that Card payment is not implemented and must not be selectable, which necessarily qualifies the FAQ's rendered fiat-payment availability statement.
The message delegates Discord welcome-bot setup and neither changes FAQ copy nor establishes that Discord is already an active support channel.
The client accepts the uniquely identified conditional claim-button behavior, requiring the FAQ's prize-collection instructions to describe winner-initiated claiming after eligibility.
